claims.sourceText: MITRE National Security Engineering Center fact sheet, 3 March 2022
claims.text: NSEC is MITRE's DoD-sponsored FFRDC under USD(R&E), delivering research, engineering and analytical solutions to the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community, with a lineage MITRE dates to 1958.

edges.label: MITRE operates NSEC for the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering
edges.note: NSEC is MITRE's only DoD/IC-sponsored FFRDC, funded at roughly $1.43 billion in FY2024 and executed through Army task orders under IDIQ W56KGU18D0004.
